results: 1. Complete neurological examination, including cranial nerves, strength, tone, reflexes, sensation, coordination, gait, and upper motor neuron signs
coordination examination (limb and truncal): left upper-limb dysmetria and dysdiadochokinesia; truncal coordination normal
3. MRI of the brain with diffusion-weighted imaging
brain MRI: thalamic lesion (tuberculoma) that DECREASED in size after anti-tuberculous treatment, with no gliosis
MRI cervical and thoracic spine: normal
5. Complete blood count, electrolytes, calcium, magnesium, renal and liver function tests
serum electrolytes, urea and creatinine: normal
serum calcium, magnesium and phosphate: normal
6. Serum vitamin B12, thyroid-stimulating hormone, and copper levels
vitamin B12 with methylmalonic acid: normal
copper / caeruloplasmin / 24 h urinary copper: normal
dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Cotard-type nihilistic delusion (delusion of being headless), most likely secondary to the left thalamic tuberculoma

Somatoparaphrenia or other body-schema disturbance related to the thalamic lesion

Functional neurological symptom disorder with limb sensory symptoms and abnormal body perception

Primary psychotic disorder with a nihilistic somatic delusion
